chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: After Heard: Kirby, Dud Bascomb and Dizzy's 1948 telegram
summary: Heartbroken, he did short stints with John Kirby and Dud Bascomb at the Apollo Bar and Grill before Dizzy telegrammed him in 1948.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, let's see, what did I do after that? Well that job actually broke my heart, it really did. I was a little lost there for a little while. And then I did four or five weeks with John Kirby at the Apollo Bar and Grill. Then I did the same job with Doug Bascomb.
The Apollo Bar and Grill, that was next to...
No, that was a block away from the Apollo Theater. And, what else did I do? Well, I worked around and gigged with different people, but then in 1948 Dizzy called me. You know, he sent
me a telegram and then I joined his band. Yeah.
